gate1_history.note: Historical F1 (phase-c26) evaluated gsplat rasterization backend on a different cohort (room 1,593,376 Gaussian, SH-degree-3, camera 5) and found only SH-color recompute minor (R=0.269). SRR0 targets FasterGSFused preprocess_backward (scale/covariance/projection/SH-direction recompute) — different backend + different recomputed quantities + different cohort. Not SAME_TARGET_SAME_BACKEND, so no DROP_PRIOR_NEGATIVE_COVERS_TARGET.

gate2_source_lock.note: preprocess_backward_cu recomputation enumerated from source; candidates R1/R2/R3 frozen before profiling.

gate3_prior_art.note: No public 3DGS backend found that explicitly selects a retained minimal forward state for projection/SH backward via a measured compute-memory Pareto policy. Internal LAW-REPLAY (ReplayGS CLOSED) and LAW-PSC/PSC-GS (CLOSED) are mechanism-adjacent priors, not a direct source-cohort collision with F1.

gate4_compute_headroom.note: Recompute preprocess_backward = 1.42/6.18/3.59 ms (room/garden/bicycle). Iteration is launch-bound (GPU idle ~74% of stream). Optimistic E2E ceiling under every valid denominator: async 1.011/1.044/1.028, stream 1.010/1.044/1.025, wall 1.012/1.048/1.030. Only garden reaches 1.04x; 1/3 < 2/3 required.

gate5_state_bytes.note: Sequential early-exit at Gate 4. Advisory byte budget computed in SRR0_STATE_BYTES.json.

gate6_numerical.note: Requires Gate 5 pass; not run. No altered training; frozen checkpoints only.

rationale: The FasterGSFused preprocess_backward recomputation targets global-3D quantities (SH direction/basis, scale->variance, quaternion->rotation, 3D covariance/RSS, camera projection, EWA Jacobian). Measured on EPIC-05 A100 against frozen iso checkpoints, the recompute is 1.4-6.2 ms/iter but the iteration is launch-bound (~124-148 ms/iter, GPU idle ~74% between kernels). Even granting the most optimistic assumption (recompute fully removed and fully on the critical path), only garden reaches the 1.04x E2E ceiling; room and bicycle fall well short. This independently confirms internal LAW-PSC (global-3D work ~4%) and LAW-REPLAY (mathematical reusability != GPU-cheap materialization). No compute headroom => SRR0 is not worth SRR1 minimal-retention engineering.
prior_negative_consistency: Consistent with CLOSED_DIRECTIONS LAW-REPLAY and LAW-PSC/PSC-GS.
